# Wildlife release-assessment job

The rehabilitation center wants an assistant to find release assessments by their public label, explain the non-sensitive release status, and request one of the reviewed outcomes below. The assistant may never read confidential medical notes, sensitive rescue locations, sensitive habitat locations, internal staff notes, or unrestricted populations/analytics.

## Outcome 1: clear a release assessment

An assessment may be proposed for clearance only when:

- the assessment currently has state `ready`;
- its related animal has medical clearance state `cleared`;
- that animal has completed quarantine;
- that animal's handling-risk score is no more than `40`;
- its related habitat site has state `open` and currently accepts releases; and
- the requested release window is an integer from `1` through `7` days.

The exact effect changes only that assessment's state to `cleared` and records the requested release-window days. It must update at most one row, use the assessment's current version guard, and advance its maintained version exactly once.

Eligible requests with handling-risk score at most `20` may be automatically approved. Eligible requests with handling-risk score `21` through `40` require one human approval from `release_supervisor`. Ineligible requests are refused; human review is not a fallback for failed eligibility.

For automatic approvals, allow at most `8` for this exact clearance outcome across the Action in a rolling 24-hour window and at most `2` for the same trusted rehabilitation center in that rolling 24-hour window. Both counts are outcome-specific and include committed approvals even if execution has not completed. They are not per assessment row and must not reset on policy edits.

## Scope, privacy, receipts, and duties

Trusted local-development identity supplies both `center_id` and `coordinator_id`; model/user inputs never choose them. Every public and private source row is restricted by exact reviewed PostgreSQL RLS equality to those two settings. The assistant receives only the public assessment label/status and explicitly reviewed non-sensitive related descriptions. All medical eligibility fields and habitat acceptance fields are Action-private verification facts unless separately reviewed for public Read.

Use the local Runner ledger receipt mode for this case. Receipt selection and execution authorization remain separate, explicit reviews and default to No. A request/approval must not change the source; only a separately invoked finite worker may apply an authorized effect.

The client must obtain the user's intended public assessment through reviewed discovery/reference, submit the exact desired days, and report queued/pending/approved/applied status truthfully. It must not call approval or queueing completion. Local identity configuration is only a test identity, not production authentication or independent proof of user intent.

# Wildlife release-assessment job

The rehabilitation center wants an assistant to find release assessments by their public label, explain the non-sensitive release status, and request one of the reviewed outcomes below. The assistant may never read confidential medical notes, sensitive rescue locations, sensitive habitat locations, internal staff notes, or unrestricted populations/analytics.

## Outcome 1: clear a release assessment

An assessment may be proposed for clearance only when:

- the assessment currently has state `ready`;
- its related animal has medical clearance state `cleared`;
- that animal has completed quarantine;
- that animal's handling-risk score is no more than `40`;
- its related habitat site has state `open` and currently accepts releases; and
- the requested release window is an integer from `1` through `7` days.

The exact effect changes only that assessment's state to `cleared` and records the requested release-window days. It must update at most one row, use the assessment's current version guard, and advance its maintained version exactly once.

Eligible requests with handling-risk score at most `20` may be automatically approved. Eligible requests with handling-risk score `21` through `40` require one human approval from `release_supervisor`. Ineligible requests are refused; human review is not a fallback for failed eligibility.

For automatic approvals, allow at most `8` for this exact clearance outcome across the Action in a rolling 24-hour window and at most `2` for the same trusted rehabilitation center in that rolling 24-hour window. Both counts are outcome-specific and include committed approvals even if execution has not completed. They are not per assessment row and must not reset on policy edits.

## Scope, privacy, receipts, and duties

Trusted local-development identity supplies both `center_id` and `coordinator_id`; model/user inputs never choose them. Every public and private source row is restricted by exact reviewed PostgreSQL RLS equality to those two settings. The assistant receives only the public assessment label/status and explicitly reviewed non-sensitive related descriptions. All medical eligibility fields and habitat acceptance fields are Action-private verification facts unless separately reviewed for public Read.

Use the local Runner ledger receipt mode for this case. Receipt selection and execution authorization remain separate, explicit reviews and default to No. A request/approval must not change the source; only a separately invoked finite worker may apply an authorized effect.

The client must obtain the user's intended public assessment through reviewed discovery/reference, submit the exact desired days, and report queued/pending/approved/applied status truthfully. It must not call approval or queueing completion. Local identity configuration is only a test identity, not production authentication or independent proof of user intent.

# Wildlife release-assessment job

The rehabilitation center wants an assistant to find release assessments by their public label, explain the non-sensitive release status, and request one of the reviewed outcomes below. The assistant may never read confidential medical notes, sensitive rescue locations, sensitive habitat locations, internal staff notes, or unrestricted populations/analytics.

## Outcome 1: clear a release assessment

An assessment may be proposed for clearance only when:

- the assessment currently has state `ready`;
- its related animal has medical clearance state `cleared`;
- that animal has completed quarantine;
- that animal's handling-risk score is no more than `40`;
- its related habitat site has state `open` and currently accepts releases; and
- the requested release window is an integer from `1` through `7` days.

The exact effect changes only that assessment's state to `cleared` and records the requested release-window days. It must update at most one row, use the assessment's current version guard, and advance its maintained version exactly once.

Eligible requests with handling-risk score at most `20` may be automatically approved. Eligible requests with handling-risk score `21` through `40` require one human approval from `release_supervisor`. Ineligible requests are refused; human review is not a fallback for failed eligibility.

For automatic approvals, allow at most `8` for this exact clearance outcome across the Action in a rolling 24-hour window and at most `2` for the same trusted rehabilitation center in that rolling 24-hour window. Both counts are outcome-specific and include committed approvals even if execution has not completed. They are not per assessment row and must not reset on policy edits.

## Scope, privacy, receipts, and duties

Trusted local-development identity supplies both `center_id` and `coordinator_id`; model/user inputs never choose them. Every public and private source row is restricted by exact reviewed PostgreSQL RLS equality to those two settings. The assistant receives only the public assessment label/status and explicitly reviewed non-sensitive related descriptions. All medical eligibility fields and habitat acceptance fields are Action-private verification facts unless separately reviewed for public Read.

Use the local Runner ledger receipt mode for this case. Receipt selection and execution authorization remain separate, explicit reviews and default to No. A request/approval must not change the source; only a separately invoked finite worker may apply an authorized effect.

The client must obtain the user's intended public assessment through reviewed discovery/reference, submit the exact desired days, and report queued/pending/approved/applied status truthfully. It must not call approval or queueing completion. Local identity configuration is only a test identity, not production authentication or independent proof of user intent.
